correctness.rationale: Categorical product has vertices (i,c), i mod8, c in{0,1,2,3}, with edges exactly adjacent cycle indices and unequal colors, not Cartesian or strong product. Independent enumeration and separate circular 16-state transfer yield the complete face-size vector 1,32,400,2560,9400,21440,33040,37728,34488,26336,16896,8864,3648,1120,240,32,2 (196,226 nonempty). An independently reconstructed staged matching leaves one critical vertex, five 4-cells and eight 5-cells after 98,106 pairs; all 1,457,216 Hasse relations pass full directed topological sort. Signed gradient-path elimination gives the displayed 5×8 ∂5 with equal nonzero rows 1/3 and another independent row4, rank2 and determinant ±1 maximal 2-minor. Hence integer Smith nonzero factors units; 4-skeleton wedge5 S4 and attaching maps of eight 5-cells classified by π4(wedge5 S4)=Z5, so homotopy cancels two unit 4/5 pairs, yielding 3 S4 vee 6 S5. Finite exact exhaustive proof for this fixed 32-vertex graph, not for all n and q. This was independently recomputed rather than trusting VERIFY_OK.
